notes: The panel froze at securing while get_chat_state reported the same link ready with a clean 36 ms trace. The daemon was right and the screen was stale, and the cause is one line of history: from 5.80.8 through 5.80.10 the server panel's repaint loop called chatServersPoll and NO SUCH FUNCTION WAS EVER DEFINED. The call shipped; the definition did not — git log -S shows exactly one commit ever touching the name, and it adds only the call. The first repaint of a moving link threw a ReferenceError inside an async continuation, AFTER the panel had painted once, so the panel showed whatever phase it
